Iconic Super Groundcar. Upgrades: Armored Chassis (w/ Stalwart Shell), Bulletproof Glass [x2], Communications Center, TUp (Turbocharged) Improved Engine, NOS [x3], Seating Upgrade, Security Upgrade (Advanced). Also: TUp (Improved) Racing Tires. Racing tires: +2 to Maneuvers on pavement. Ablation to its SP is 1 less (min 0). Basic driving needs Drive Land Vehicle Skill Base 14. A supercar in a Combat Cab's paint, checkered band, meter and roof light: nobody expects the taxi to do 400. It answers one call in a thousand, and only Sasquatch drives it.

Cost: Not for sale (Super Luxury)
Nomad: 10 (Combat Cab)
SDP: 50
SP: 13
Seats: 4
MOVE: 80
Speed: 400 mph
